note: Densities are typical values from mindat.org mineral pages. Element contents are computed from formula and IUPAC atomic weights, except where an explicit composition is declared with its source.

name: Iron-bearing silicate gangue
Ganga silicatada con hierro
silicate_fe.source: Declared composite silicate gangue for a magnetite ore (quartz with amphibole and minor iron silicates); composition authored.

name: Bornite
Bornita
bornite.source: Handbook of Mineralogy (Anthony et al. 2001-2005), bornite: D(meas.) 5.06 to 5.08, D(calc.) 5.074 t/m3.

name: Chalcocite
Calcosina
chalcocite.source: Handbook of Mineralogy (Anthony et al. 2001-2005), chalcocite: D(meas.) 5.5 to 5.8, D(calc.) 5.80 t/m3.

name: Sphalerite (iron-bearing)
Esfalerita (con hierro)
sphalerite.source: mindat.org sphalerite, 3.9 to 4.1 t/m3; 8 mol% Fe substitution declared.

name: Pentlandite
Pentlandita
pentlandite.source: mindat.org pentlandite, 4.6 to 5.0 t/m3; Fe:Ni 1:1 declared.

name: Chrysocolla
Crisocola
chrysocolla.source: mindat.org chrysocolla, variable (Cu,Al)2H2Si2O5(OH)4.nH2O, 1.93 to 2.4 t/m3; 33% Cu declared.

name: Native gold (electrum)
Oro nativo (electrum)
electrum.source: Electrum at 73% Au as measured by MLA in Laplante and Staunton (AMIRA P420B); density from the Au and Ag end members.

name: Clay (kaolinite)
Arcilla (caolinita)
kaolinite.source: Handbook of Mineralogy (Anthony, Bideaux, Bladh and Nichols, Mineral Data Publishing, 2001), kaolinite: D(meas.) 2.61 to 2.68, D(calc.) 2.63 t/m3; the calculated value. Until 0.09.000 the table held 2.6, outside the measured range (review of 2026-10-04, F-06).
